evidence.text: In this case do you even need a RAG? Most models will have been trained on Wikipedia anyway. Give Jan ( https://www.jan.ai/ ) a try for instance. You'll need to do a bit of research as to what model will give you the best perf on your system but one of the quantized Llama or Qwen models will probably suit you well.
